business_problem: Company leadership also wanted to embrace more advanced AI and unified analytics solutions.
solution_summary: NETZSCH Group modernized its analytics estate on Microsoft Copilot, Power BI, Power Platform, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Operational, enterprise, or sensor data is ingested into a shared cloud store and transformed with Azure engineering services so teams can work from one current source of truth. Power BI then serves dashboards, self-service exploration, and decision support to business users at scale. The interoperability of the two solutions, Lautenschlager reports, has reduced data transfer times far more than the company initially expected. The architecture emphasizes managed services, reusable integrations, and governed data handling so the organization can scale adoption without rebuilding the solution for each new team or use case.
